title: Criminal Sexual Contact
grade_or_penalty: Aggravated criminal sexual contact: 3rd degree. Criminal sexual contact: 4th degree
key_points: Sexual contact (intentional touching for degradation or sexual gratification) under the circumstances listed in 2C:14-2.
Aggravated version uses the aggravated sexual assault circumstances.
elements: The suspect committed an act of sexual contact (intentional touching of intimate parts, directly or through clothing, to degrade or humiliate the victim or for sexual arousal or gratification)
Under one of the circumstances listed in 2C:14-2 (force or coercion, victim's age, helplessness, etc.)

subsections.label: a
subsections.text: Aggravated criminal sexual contact: sexual contact under any circumstance in 2C:14-2a(2)-(7)

subsections.label: b
subsections.text: Criminal sexual contact: sexual contact under any circumstance in 2C:14-2c(1)-(4)
